note: Private park in Berea a quarter mile west of I-75 exit 76, its pull-through sites in long rows on open lawn with scattered shade trees. Most sites are full hookup, a few water and electric only. Pool open Memorial Day to Labor Day, propane fills and a convenience store; Conestoga wagons are rented as lodging. Monthly stays are by application only. --Claude
